patch_description:
This crossover merges the interspersed entanglement layering from the inspiration program with the collective parameter sharing strategy of the current program. The inspiration model suffered from overfitting due to having independent parameters for every qubit in every layer, whereas the current program clumped all entangling gates together, which limited its expressiveness. 

By inserting layers of parameterized, collectively-shared `RY` rotations between each dimensional grouping of the hypercube `CZ` gates, we significantly boost the expressiveness and entangling capability of each block. Because the parameters are shared across all wires (vertex symmetry), the total parameter count remains extremely low (6 per block). This provides strong regularization, matching the excellent generalization of the current program while leveraging the superior architectural depth of the inspiration program.
